note: Starter content written for the hackathon. The team must check every condition list and red flag against public patient-education sources (e.g. MedlinePlus, NHS) before the demo. Not medical advice.

severity_0_10.zh: 如果 0 是完全不难受，10 是你能想象到的最难受，现在大概几分？
severity_0_10.en: If 0 is no discomfort and 10 is the worst you can imagine, how bad is it right now?

onset.zh: 大概是什么时候开始的？

character.zh: 它更像哪种感觉？可以选，也可以用自己的话说。
character.en: What does it feel like? Pick one or describe it in your own words.

location.zh: 具体在身体哪个位置？会不会窜到别的地方？
location.en: Where exactly in your body is it? Does it spread anywhere?

associated.zh: 同时还有别的不舒服吗？
associated.en: Is anything else bothering you at the same time?

aggravating.zh: 有没有什么会让它更厉害？比如活动、吃东西、光线或压力？
aggravating.en: Does anything make it worse, like movement, eating, light or stress?

relieving.zh: 有什么能让它好一点吗？
relieving.en: Does anything make it a bit better?

duration.en: How long does each episode last?

medication.zh: 这次有吃药或用别的方法吗？效果怎么样？
medication.en: Did you take any medicine or try anything else? Did it help?

associated_question.zh: 头痛的时候，有没有下面这些情况？
associated_question.en: When you have the headache, do you also notice any of these?

zh: 看到闪光或视野缺一块

associated_question.zh: 肚子不舒服的时候，有没有下面这些情况？
associated_question.en: When your stomach bothers you, do you also notice any of these?
Do you also notice any of these?

en: Pain spreading to arm or jaw

associated_question.en: Do you also notice any of these?

associated_question.zh: 最近有没有下面这些情况？
associated_question.en: Lately, have you noticed any of these?

message.zh: 胸口不适同时伴有呼吸困难、出冷汗，或疼痛窜到手臂、下巴，可能需要紧急处理。请立即拨打 911 或去急诊。
message.en: Chest discomfort with trouble breathing, a cold sweat, or pain spreading to your arm or jaw can be an emergency. Call 911 or go to the emergency room now.

message.zh: 突然出现的、从未有过的剧烈头痛需要马上就医。请立即拨打 911 或去急诊。
message.en: A sudden, severe headache unlike any before needs urgent care. Call 911 or go to the emergency room now.

message.zh: 一侧无力、脸歪或说话不清可能是中风征兆。请立即拨打 911。
message.en: Weakness on one side, a drooping face or slurred speech can be signs of a stroke. Call 911 now.

message.zh: 吐血、便血、黑便或咳血需要尽快就医。请联系医生或去急诊。
message.en: Vomiting blood, blood in your stool, black stools or coughing up blood need prompt care. Contact a doctor or go to the emergency room.

message.zh: 晕倒或失去意识需要尽快就医，请联系医生；如果仍不舒服，请拨打 911。
message.en: Fainting or losing consciousness should be checked soon. Contact a doctor, and call 911 if you still feel unwell.

message.zh: 发烧同时脖子发僵需要马上就医。请立即拨打 911 或去急诊。
message.en: Fever together with a stiff neck needs urgent care. Call 911 or go to the emergency room now.

message.zh: 听起来你现在很难受，你不需要一个人扛着。可以随时拨打或发短信到 988（美国自杀与危机生命线）和人聊聊；如果有立即的危险，请拨打 911。
message.en: It sounds like you're going through a lot, and you don't have to handle it alone. You can call or text 988 (Suicide & Crisis Lifeline, US) any time. If you're in immediate danger, call 911.
